section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Installation of Component Parts
ocr_text:
42. INSTALL TRANSMISSION HOUSING
Install and torque the six bolts.
Torque: 10 mm Bolt 345 kg-cm (25 ft-lb, 34 N·m)
12 mm Bolt 580 kg-cm (42 ft-lb, 57 N·m)

43. INSTALL SPEED SENSOR
(a) Coat a new O-ring with ATF and install it to the speed
sensor.
(b) Install the speed sensor. Install and torque the bolt.
Torque: 160 kg-cm (12 ft-lb, 16 N·m)
(c) Connect the connector.

44. INSTALL SPEEDOMETER DRIVEN GEAR
(a) Coat a new O-ring with ATF and install it to the
speedometer driven gear.
(b) Install the speedometer driven gear. Install and tor-
que the bolt.
Torque: 160 kg-cm (12 ft-lb, 16 N·m)

45. INSTALL UNIONS
(a) Coat new two O-rings with ATF and install them to
each union.
(b) Install the front union.
Torque: 300 kg-cm (22 ft-lb, 29 N·m)

(c) Install the rear union as shown in the figure.
Torque: 300 kg-cm (22 ft-lb, 29 N·m)
